en.title: Where precision meets poetry.
paragraphs: Agenvo is a collective of architects, structural engineers, and interior designers working from Zurich and Dubai.

items.title: Architecture
items.body: Residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects from concept to completion documents.

items.title: Engineering
items.body: Structural, MEP, and sustainability consulting integrated into every design decision.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: Site analysis, client vision workshops, and feasibility studies.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: Schematic design, 3D massing, and material palette exploration.

steps.title: Development
steps.body: Detailed drawings, BIM coordination, and engineering integration.

en.title: Tell us what you are trying to build.

items.question: Do you work outside Switzerland and the UAE?
items.answer: Yes. We have built in sixteen countries across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

items.question: What size projects do you take on?
items.answer: Our work ranges from a single room or staircase to masterplans of several hundred thousand square metres.

items.question: How early should we contact you?
items.answer: As early as possible — ideally before you have purchased a site.
